invite.doc: Send a contact invitation by email. Creates a contact entry and dispatches an invitation email. For non-Drumee users, sends a signup link. For registered Drumee users on different domains, sends a notification email. Same-domain colleagues on a Paid plan cannot be invited as they are automatically in contacts.

email.doc: Email address of the person to invite

message.doc: Optional personal message to include in the invitation email

surname.doc: Middle or additional name of the invitee

returns.doc: Created or updated contact record with invitation details

entity.doc: Contact entity identifier: Drumee uid if registered, email address otherwise

uid.doc: Drumee user ID if the invitee is a registered user, null otherwise

status.doc: Contact status after invite: invitation, pending, or active

firstname.doc: First name stored for this contact

lastname.doc: Last name stored for this contact

email.doc: List of email address objects associated with this contact

input.doc: The original email address used to send the invitation

errors.message: The email address format is invalid
This email is already an active contact in your list
You already have a pending invitation from this person
Cannot invite a colleague from the same paid-plan domain; they are automatically in your contacts

invite_accept.doc: Accept a pending contact invitation from another Drumee user. Creates a bidirectional contact connection, initiates a welcome chat exchange via handshake, logs the accept activity, and notifies the inviting party via WebSocket.

email.doc: Email address of the Drumee user whose invitation you are accepting

returns.doc: Updated contact record reflecting the accepted status

uid.doc: Drumee user ID of the accepted contact

errors.message: The email address does not belong to a registered Drumee user
No pending invitation found from this user

invite_refuse.doc: Refuse a pending contact invitation from another Drumee user. Updates the invitation status, logs the refuse activity, and notifies the inviting party via WebSocket.

email.doc: Email address of the Drumee user whose invitation to refuse

uid.doc: Drumee user ID of the refusing party

errors.message: The email address does not belong to a registered Drumee user
No pending invitation found from this user

add.doc: Manually add a new contact by Drumee user ID or by email address list. These two inputs are mutually exclusive. Optionally sends an invitation email by setting invite=1.

invitee_id.doc: Drumee user ID of the contact to add. Mutually exclusive with email array.

email.doc: Array of email objects: [{ email, is_default, category }]. Required if invitee_id is not provided. One entry must have is_default=1.

mobile.doc: Array of phone objects: [{ phone, areacode, category, is_default }]

address.doc: Array of address objects: [{ street, city, country, category, is_default }]

tag.doc: Array of tag identifiers to assign to this contact

comment.doc: Internal comment or note about this contact

message.doc: Personal message included in invitation email when invite=1

invite.doc: Set to '1' to send an invitation email to the contact

returns.doc: Newly created contact record with full details

uid.doc: Drumee user ID if the contact is a registered user, null otherwise

email.doc: List of associated email addresses

errors.message: Provide either invitee_id or email array, but not both (or neither)
The provided invitee_id does not match any registered Drumee user
Cannot add a colleague from the same paid-plan domain as an external contact
Only one email address can be designated as default (is_default=1)
At least one email address must be designated as default
This contact already exists in your contact list
You cannot add yourself as a contact
Contact was created successfully but the invitation email failed to send

update.doc: Update an existing contact's information including name, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, and tags. All sub-arrays are fully replaced on update (not merged). Optionally re-sends or initiates an invitation via invite=1.

contact_id.doc: ID of the contact to update

firstname.doc: Updated first name. Required when the contact is linked to a Drumee user (uid is set).

lastname.doc: Updated last name. Required when the contact is linked to a Drumee user (uid is set).

email.doc: Replacement email list: [{ email, is_default, category }]. Fully replaces existing emails.

mobile.doc: Replacement phone list: [{ phone, areacode, category, is_default }]. Fully replaces existing phones.

address.doc: Replacement address list: [{ street, city, country, category, is_default }]. Fully replaces existing addresses.

tag.doc: Replacement tag list. Fully replaces existing tags.

message.doc: Message for invitation email (used when invite=1)

invite.doc: Set to '1' to send or re-send an invitation email

returns.doc: Updated contact record with full details

email.doc: Updated list of email addresses

errors.message: No contact found with the given contact_id
First name is required when updating a contact linked to a Drumee user
Last name is required when updating a contact linked to a Drumee user
Only one email address can be designated as default (is_default=1)
A default email address is required when is_need_email is set on this contact
The new email/entity is already used by another contact in your list
Cannot assign a same-domain colleague as an external contact
You cannot set yourself as a contact
Contact was updated successfully but the invitation email failed to send

show_contact.doc: List the current user's contacts with optional filtering by tag, name, and status. Free users (domain_id=1) see only their personal contact table. Paid users (domain_id>1) see personal contacts only; same-domain colleagues are available via my_contacts.

tag_id.doc: Filter contacts belonging to a specific tag ID. Pass empty string to show all tags.

name.doc: Search keyword to filter contacts by name (partial match)

uid.doc: Drumee user ID if the contact is a registered user

status.doc: Contact relationship status (active, archived, invitation, etc.)

email.doc: Default email address

avatar.doc: Avatar URL if the contact is a Drumee user

my_contacts.doc: Search and filter the current user's contacts. Free users (domain_id=1) see only their personal contact table. Paid users (domain_id>1) see personal contacts UNION colleagues from the same domain. Returns an empty array when the search key is empty.

value.doc: Search keyword to filter by name or email. Returns empty array if omitted or blank.

only_drumate.doc: Set to 1 to return only contacts who are registered Drumee users

status.doc: Filter by contact status (active, archived, etc.)

uid.doc: Drumee user ID (if a registered user)

email.doc: Default email address

email_in_use.doc: Check whether an email is already referenced by any of the caller's contacts — as the contact's entity (default identifier) or in their contact_email rows. Pass contact_id when editing to exclude that contact from the check.

email.doc: Email address to check

contact_id.doc: Contact ID to exclude (the one being edited)

returns.doc: Empty object when the email is free; otherwise a contact descriptor.

email.doc: The matching email address that triggered the conflict

get_contact.doc: Retrieve full details of a specific contact including all associated email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, and tags.

contact_id.doc: ID of the contact to retrieve

returns.doc: Full contact record with all nested sub-arrays

uid.doc: Drumee user ID if the contact is a registered user

email.doc: All email addresses: [{ id, email, is_default, category }]

mobile.doc: All phone numbers: [{ id, phone, areacode, category, is_default }]

address.doc: All postal addresses: [{ id, street, city, country, category, is_default }]

tag.doc: All tags associated with this contact

delete_contact.doc: Permanently delete a contact from the current user's contact list. Sends a real-time WebSocket notification to both the owner and the contact (if they are a Drumee user).

contact_id.doc: ID of the contact to permanently delete

id.doc: ID of the deleted contact record

search.doc: Search for Drumee users across the platform by keyword within the current domain. Intended for discovering potential contacts to add. Returns an empty array if the search key is blank.

key.doc: Search keyword (name or email). Returns empty array if omitted.

returns.doc: List of Drumee users matching the search keyword

email.doc: User's email address

invite_get.doc: Retrieve the list of pending contact invitations received by the current user. Used to display the invitation inbox.

email.doc: Sender's email address

created_at.doc: Unix timestamp when the invitation was sent

invite_count.doc: Get the count of pending contact invitations received by the current user. Used to display notification badges in the UI.

accept_informed.doc: Acknowledge that the current user has been notified that their sent invitation was accepted by the recipient. Transitions the contact status from 'informed' to 'active' on the sender's side and sends a WebSocket update.

email.doc: Email address of the Drumee user who accepted your invitation

errors.message: The email address does not belong to a registered Drumee user
No informed-status invitation found for this user

block.doc: Block a contact to prevent further interaction. Updates the contact relationship record for both parties and sends real-time WebSocket notifications.

contact_id.doc: ID of the contact to block

returns.doc: Full contact record reflecting the blocked status

uid.doc: Drumee user ID of the blocked contact

email.doc: Contact's email addresses

unblock.doc: Unblock a previously blocked contact, restoring the contact relationship. Sends real-time WebSocket notifications to both parties.

contact_id.doc: ID of the contact to unblock

uid.doc: Drumee user ID of the unblocked contact

email.doc: Contact's email addresses

change_status.doc: Change the status of a contact to 'active' (restore) or 'archived' (soft-archive without deletion). Sends a real-time WebSocket update to the current user's sessions.

contact_id.doc: ID of the contact whose status to change

errors.message: Status must be either 'active' or 'archived'
No contact found with the given contact_id

join.doc: Join a contact network via an invitation token received in an invitation email. Validates the token, creates the contact relationship, and returns the newly created contact record.

token.doc: Invitation token received in the invitation email link

returns.doc: Contact record created via the invitation token

email.doc: Email address objects associated with the contact

errors.message: The provided invitation token is invalid or does not exist
The invitation token has expired and is no longer active

summary.doc: Get a contact summary for a hub node. Returns the count of active contacts and the timestamp of the most recent contact modification. Requires owner-level access to the specified node.

hub_id.doc: Hub ID containing the target node

nid.doc: Node ID to retrieve the contact summary for

returns.doc: Contact summary data for the specified node

contact_count.doc: Number of active contacts associated with this node

last_updated.doc: Unix timestamp of the most recent contact modification

errors.message: The specified node does not exist in this hub
Only the node owner can retrieve the contact summary

google_auth.doc: Initiate the Google OAuth authorization flow to import contacts from Google Contacts. Returns a Google authorization URL that the user must visit to grant read-only access to their Google Contacts.

url.doc: Google OAuth 2.0 authorization URL. Redirect the user to this URL to begin the consent flow.

invitation_status.doc: Check the status of a contact invitation using its token. Public endpoint (no authentication required) used to display the invitation landing page before the recipient logs in.

token.doc: Invitation token from the invitation email URL

uid.doc: Optional Drumee user ID to provide additional context about the recipient

status.doc: Current invitation status (active, expired, used, etc.)

sender.doc: Information about the user who sent the invitation

email.doc: Email address the invitation was sent to

load.doc: Import contacts from an uploaded CSV or VCF (vCard) file. Processes the file and reports real-time import progress via WebSocket using socket_id. Each entry requires at least one email address. Supports .csv and .vcf formats.

socket_id.doc: WebSocket session ID for streaming real-time progress updates during import

uploaded_id.doc: ID of the file from an upload operation. Mutually exclusive with secret.

secret.doc: Legacy file ID. Mutually exclusive with uploaded_id.

service.doc: Optional service tag used in WebSocket progress messages

total.doc: Total number of contact entries found in the file

noemail.doc: Number of entries skipped because they had no email address

alreadyincontact.doc: Number of entries skipped because they already exist in the contact list

errors.message: No file ID was provided; either uploaded_id or secret is required
Both uploaded_id and secret were provided; only one is allowed at a time
The uploaded file is not a supported format; only .csv and .vcf are accepted

connection_status.doc: Retrieve the current online/offline presence state of all contacts. Used to display real-time presence indicators in the contact list.

returns.doc: List of contact presence state records

uid.doc: Drumee user ID of the contact

online.doc: Whether the contact is currently online

last_seen.doc: Unix timestamp of the contact's last seen activity
